title: Cross-mission canonical artifact input binding — governed consume of ACCEPTED artifacts from sibling missions
description: Fixes FAIL_CLOSED_PLAN_DATAFLOW_UNBOUND_INPUT for bound missions consuming artifacts ACCEPTED by earlier sibling missions. Seam: ArtifactDependencyResolver.listEligibleExternalInputSources — CANONICAL lineage proof via validateWorkOpenBindingById (consumer mission<->BOUND WOB<->delegated work item, PROVENANCE) + assertCanonicalWorkforceAllocationProvenance (exactly-one WAL<->objective<->business; malformed/forged/cross-business/non-BOUND sibling lineage throws FAIL_CLOSED_EXTERNAL_INPUT_LINEAGE, never row-membership auth). F2 producer terminal authority: producerPassAnchored requires COMPLETED execution + governed linkage + exactly-one anchored RESULT_VALIDATED PASS whose artifact_ids contain the artifact; RUNNING/FAILED/unvalidated producers excluded. F3: cap enforced on ELIGIBLE set only (after all filters), 63/64/65 boundary + unrelated-artifact tests. bindPlanExternalInputs stamps reserved pair_dataflow_sources pinning consume_name+immutable identity: 1 match binds, 0 UNBOUND, >1 AMBIGUOUS; stamps stripped; drift/conflict SOURCE_BINDING. requiredEdges exempts only source-bound consumes; assert re-proves CURRENT eligibility. Reconcile/runPlanning/replan thread input_artifact_sources; resolveForConsumer re-proves NOW -> canonical pins; materialize derives producer mission from durable exec row. 25 tests on canonical fixtures (real objectives/workstreams/WAL/openWorkItem mint) + INT1 production-path (real MissionRuntime tick: planner receives eligible set, plan commits bound stamps). Regression: f2 53 + dataflow-incident 125 + f1 20 + f2-r1 43 pass; baseline flake f4 R5.1-crash fails identically on BASE 1f6d4af.
